Description:

A maritime security role is available for a Chief Security Officer (CSO) responsible for overseeing cargo operations, vessel trim and stability, and navigational watchkeeping. The position requires a relevant maritime certification, proven experience in vessel security management (ISPS/SSO), and strong knowledge of international maritime codes. Key responsibilities include leading deck crew, coordinating emergency drills, and ensuring compliance with SOLAS, MARPOL, STCW, ISM, and ISPS. This role involves deck department administration and preparations for port state/class surveys.
